method: Authorized visible native UI, exact query filter manually selected and typed. Screenshots verified applied filter, current/prior cards, page table and all four country rows. No raw private app screenshots retained in public repository.
limitations: Page and country views were separately conditioned on exact query; no simultaneous country-plus-page-plus-device filter was read.
Current and previous absolute periods inherited the independently verified applied 28-day comparison. No zero-impression position is interpreted as rank zero.
These are observed sparse site exposures, not market search volumes, stable rankings, customers, sessions or release-attributed outcomes.
The same 20 current impressions also occur in the overlapping weekly export; never add the two periods.
incidentalUiHandling: One stale AX index selected google ads audit checklist instead of intended query. Screenshot identified mismatch; filter was removed before explicit exact-query entry. No values from that incidental view used for target-query attribution. Finally removed target-query filter; overall report left available, original unrelated property tab untouched.
